title: Griffith Mansion
geometryBasis: The registered federal NAIP roof and entrance approach establish scale and heading. Cleared front and rear views establish the two projecting bay forms, porch and attached ranges; wall lines are inferred under roof edges and tree cover.
sectionBasis: Exact June 2009 ground-level originals establish white painted horizontal siding, arched sash, Corinthian porch columns and a deep bracketed eave. Roof and story heights are estimated using windows, doors, columns and the roof footprint.
limitations: The June 2009 exterior omits interiors, detached buildings and private landscape features. The extent of obscured wall lines, rear windows and roof folds is approximate. Columns, brackets and sash ornament are simplified.
Federal orthophotography controls scale and position. The original terrain remains unchanged. Step and threshold contact is approximate.
